programs.desc: Charlie wins first prize at school for his fantastic homemade rocket which he made from 10 yoghurt pots and some extra wide tin foil.

programs.desc: Lola is horrified because she has her first ever wobbly tooth and she does not ever, never want her wobbly tooth to fall out.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Introducing Charlie on clarinet and Marv on keyboards! The boys are presenting a piece all about Outer Space accompanied with music in front of the whole school tomorrow in assembly.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola simply doesn't have time to play today; she's far too extremely busy organising her office full of mermaids, running her own café, dentist and library.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Eddie Gourmand has built a super attraction park, made completely out of cheese. Squeak and his friends beg Garfield to take them there but with Harry working as a security guard, it won't be easy!

programs.desc: Pooky has disappeared again, but this time, it's Nermal who finds it. He is willing to give it back to him at one condition: Garfield has to be really nice to Nermal for the rest of the day!

programs.desc: Nermal doesn't believe in super heroes. Garfield does and he tries desperately to convince him. Even if that means disguising himself as Ultra Powerful Guy.

programs.desc: Garfield receives a strange helmet which lets him read everyone's thoughts. He even catches aliens' conversations who are just about to conquer Earth! Garfield has to stop this plot immediately!

programs.desc: Nermal makes a bet with Garfield: if Garfield manages not to eat for a whole hour, he won't see Nermal for a whole month. Will Garfield be victorious ?

programs.desc: A caveman has been found in a block of ice. When Garfield accidentally thaws him, he falls in love with Olga. But if there's no caveman in the new exhibit, the museum will be ruined!

programs.title: The Garfield Show

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Jon's Christmas plans take a turn for the unexpected, prompting Garfield to learn that there's more to Christmas than opening presents and eating!

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: How can Garfield make the cutest cat in the country look ugly? It won't be easy but our orange friend is VERY motivated...

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: Ah! A pizza dinner in a countryside cottage, doesn't that sound nice? Yep, except when the house is haunted.

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: How can Garfield get rid of Aunt Ivy, who hates animals? Garfield has an idea.

programs.desc: Yahooooo! Jon has won the lottery!!! But... but where is his ticket?

programs.desc: Bad news: Jon's nieces are coming over! The ones who love to dress Garfield up? You got it.

programs.desc: Jon has become allergic to Garfield. But what if the only solution is to get rid of him?

programs.desc: Garfield has always said he would go to the ends of the earth to eat lasagna. And that's exactly what he's going to do!

programs.title: The Garfield Show
programs.desc: In your opinion, who should you call to rid a house of mice? An exterminator, or Garfield?

programs.desc: Odie is accidentally sold to Mr. Allwork, an awful lawyer who wants to sue Jon, and Garfield must find a way to get him back or never be fed again!

programs.desc: Jon, Odie and especially Garfield have to put up with an unexpected houseguest with big demands and an even bigger appetite.

programs.title: The Garfield Show

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Sally and Nick try to stump each other by guessing the animal sounds they're making. Then, Sally plays dress up but her favourite hat no longer has any feathers on it! Where can they find more?

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Sally and Nick are practising for a three-legged race, but walking on three legs is hard! Then, the kids visit Dr. Twiggles in Fluff'n Stuff Fields.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Nick's hungry tummy is rumbling! But why do our stomachs make noises when they're hungry? Then, Nick and Sally help Cat put his model of the solar system back together!

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: The Cat takes the kids to the Jungle of Bingle-Bungle Boo to meet his friends Emily the Teal, Mikey the Lemur and Greg the Gecko. Then, Nick and Sally pretend to be The Cat in the Hat.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Sally and Nick are off to the Twisty-Misty Mountains to meet Gordon the Gorilla. Cat knows some lizard friends who are oh-so like dragons. They can show Nick and Sally how to pretend to be dragons.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Sally, Nick and Cat are playing with their toy rocket. Then, Nick and Sally are wiggling and jiggling like the jelly mould in front of them.

programs.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programs.desc: Sally and Nick are trying to wrap a present for their mums but they're having problems. Then, there's a frog in Nick and Sally's pool! They have to get him out but can't catch him...
